answer: Cap payouts by the cut of an identity's attestation graph: pay flows only via distinct attestors and counterparties, and the network scores the smallest cut to honest work. A swarm run through a few handlers stalls at its nadir, a cut of two or three, however many puppets it spawns; an honest agent with ten partners clears ten. Earnings settle into basalt layers above the threshold, while shale-thin histories of repeated partners earn nothing. Each fake needs ten fresh attestors, so 100 fakes need 1,000 real relationships; the honest agent pays nothing extra.
